IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'DimCustomerCorp_CRM') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.DimCustomerCorp_CRM;
END;
WITH
CustomerAction 
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CustomerAction A
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode, MAX(CustomerActionTimestamp) CustomerActionTimestamp FROM BNKM.CustomerAction GROUP BY CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode ) B
		ON A.CustomerId = B.CustomerId AND A.CustomerActionTypeId = B.CustomerActionTypeId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
		AND A.SourceCode = B.SourceCode AND A.CustomerActionTimestamp = B.CustomerActionTimestamp
	WHERE A.SourceCode = 'CRM'
)

SELECT DISTINCT BC.CUSTOMERID 
    ,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
    ,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2
    ,BCTY.CityName                      AS City
    ,BSTT.StateName                     AS Province
    ,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode
    ,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
	,BN.NationalityName                 AS Nationality
    ,BCST.ConsentName                   AS DataPrivacyConsent
    ,BACT.CustomerActionTimestamp       AS LastKYCDate
    ,BC.SuspendedIndicator              AS SuspendedIndicator
    ,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2
    ,BCTY2.CityName                     AS OfficeCity
    ,BSTT2.StateName                    AS OfficeProvince
    ,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
    ,BCTRY.IsoCountryName               AS OfficeCountry
    ,BAZC.AnzsicClassName               AS Industry
    ,BJT.JobTitleName                   AS Occupation
    ,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
    into DW.DimCustomerCorp_CRM
    FROM (SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,SuspendedIndicator FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM') BC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc  ) rn, CustomerId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND (@DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and CONVERT(DATE,replace(isnull(PeriodEndTimestamp,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) )) BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId  AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCTN.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCTN.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY ConsentId  ) rn, CustomerId,ConsentId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM  BNKM.CustomerConsent where PeriodEndDate is NULL) BCC ON BC.CustomerId = BCC.CustomerId  AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCC.RN = 1--WITH ISSUE PK ON CONSENTID
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ConsentId,ConsentName FROM BNKM.Consent) BCST ON BCC.ConsentId = BCST.ConsentId --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, MAX(CustomerActionTimestamp) AS CustomerActionTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode FROM CustomerAction GROUP BY CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode) BACT ON BC.CustomerId = BACT.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BACT.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc ) rn, CustomerId,LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND (@DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and CONVERT(DATE,replace(isnull(PeriodEndTimestamp,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) )) BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCL.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCL.RN = 1--duplicates
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationZipCode,CountryId ,LocationCity,LocationStateId,FinancialInstitutionId  FROM BNKM.Location) BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId AND BCL.FinancialInstitutionId = BLOC.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc, InsertDttm desc, EmailAddress) rn,CustomerId,EmailTypeId,EmailAddress,FinancialInstitutionId,  SourceCode  FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND (@DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and CONVERT(DATE,replace(isnull(PeriodEndTimestamp,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) )) BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCE.FinancialInstitutionId and BCE.RN =1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CityId,CityName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.City) BCTY ON BLOC.LocationCity = BCTY.CityId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCTY.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT StateId,StateName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.[STATE]) BSTT   ON BLOC.LocationStateId = BSTT.StateId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BSTT.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT row_number() over(partition by customerid,FinancialInstitutionId order by customerid,JobTitleId) rn, CustomerId,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),EmployerId,1) EmployerId,JobTitleId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCEMP.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCEMP.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT row_number() over(partition by EmployerId,FinancialInstitutionId order by EmployerId,EmployerName) rn, EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,AnzsicClassCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Employer) BEMP ON BCEMP.EmployerId = BEMP.EmployerId AND BCEMP.FinancialInstitutionId = BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId AND BEMP.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CityId,CityName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.City) BCTY2 ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.CityId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCTY2.CityId) AND BCTY2.FinancialInstitutionId = BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId    
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT StateId,StateName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.[STATE]) BSTT2   ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.StateId) = convert(varchar,BSTT2.StateId) AND BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId = BSTT2.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CountryId,IsoCountryName FROM BNKM.Country) BCTRY ON  BEMP.Country = convert(varchar,BCTRY.CountryId) 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT AnzsicClassCode,AnzsicClassName FROM BNKM.AnzsicClass) BAZC ON BEMP.AnzsicClassCode = BAZC.AnzsicClassCode 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT JobTitleId,JobTitleName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.JobTitle )  BJT ON BCEMP.JobTitleId = BJT.JobTitleId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BJT.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CCC.NationalityId, CCC.CustomerId
    FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartDate DESC) AS RN, NationalityId, CustomerId 
    FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship) CCC
    WHERE CCC.RN = 1) BCCC ON BC.CustomerId = BCCC.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT NationalityId, NationalityName FROM BNKM.Nationality) BN ON BCCC.NationalityId = BN.NationalityId
    WHERE BC.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP;
END;

WITH
CustomerSK
as (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomer
)
,BOBAccount AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
    BC.CustomerId
    FROM BNKM.Customer BC
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP ON BC.CoreCustomerId = BCAP.CoreCustomerId
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount BOBA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BOBA.RelatedCustomerAccountId
    WHERE BCAP.SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP', 'LNS') AND BOBA.ID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM CustomerSK)  AS CustomerSK, * INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
 BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,BLEC.LegalEntityName AS CustomerName
,BCT.CustomerTypeName AS CustomerType
,NULL AS DateOfBirth
,BMS.MaritalStatusName AS MaritalStatus
,NULL AS Gender
,TMPCCS.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
,TMPCCS.Email AS Email
,TMPCCS.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
,TMPCCS.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,TMPCCS.City AS City
,TMPCCS.Province AS Province
,TMPCCS.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,TMPCCS.Country AS Country
,TMPCCS.Nationality AS Nationality
,TMPCCS.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
,TMPCCS.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
--,TMPCCS.RiskRatingTypeSK AS RiskRatingTypeSK  --removed
--,TMPCCS.RiskRatingSK AS RiskRatingSK   --removed
,TMPCCS.SuspendedIndicator AS SuspendedIndicator
,BC.CustomerEstablishedDate AS RelationshipStartDate
,BCRP.PartyId AS GlobalCIF
,BC.CustomerId AS FCBSCIF
,CASE WHEN BCRC.RelatedCustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,CASE WHEN BCA.CustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator --MBK
--,CASE WHEN BCA2.CustomerId IS NOT NULL OR BCAP.CoreCustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator --RIB/BOB
,CASE WHEN BC.CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM BOBAccount) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,NULL AS GenerationalCohortSK
,TMPCCS.EmployerName
,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine1
,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine2
,TMPCCS.OfficeCity
,TMPCCS.OfficeProvince
,TMPCCS.OfficeZipCode
,TMPCCS.OfficeCountry
,TMPCCS.Industry
,TMPCCS.Occupation
,BLEC.LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment AS DateOfIncorporation
,BLEC.SMEClassification AS SMEClassification
,BLEC.AnzsicClassCode AS LineOfActivity
,AnzsicClassName AS IndustryDescription
,BLEC.SectorCode AS Subsector
,BSTOR.SectorName AS SubsectorDescription
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,BC.BranchId AS BranchSK
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,convert(date,'9999-12-31') AS ValidEndDate
,BC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Customer BC
JOIN DW.DimCustomerCorp_CRM TMPCCS ON BC.CustomerId = TMPCCS.CUSTOMERID AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = TMPCCS.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LegalEntityName,SMEClassification,AnzsicClassCode,SectorCode,CustomerId,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer) BLEC ON BC.CustomerId  = BLEC.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty where @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATE,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')  )  BCRP ON BC.CustomerId = BCRP.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCRP.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerType BCT ON BC.CustomerTypeId= CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCT.CustomerTypeId) AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE @DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and CONVERT(DATE,replace(isnull(PeriodEnddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) ) BCMS ON BC.CustomerId = BCMS.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.MaritalStatus BMS ON BCMS.MaritalStatusId  = convert(varchar,BMS.MaritalStatusId)

LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT RelatedCustomerId FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer where @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATE,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') ) BCRC ON BC.CustomerId = BCRC.RelatedCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount where SourceSystemCode = 'MBK' ) BCA ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.CustomerId) 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount where SourceSystemCode = 'RIB' ) BCA2 ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA2.CustomerId)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CoreCustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP
            JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId FROM BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount) BOBA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BOBA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP','LNS')
            ) BCAP ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BC.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN BNKM.AnzsicClass BAZC ON  BLEC.AnzsicClassCode = BAZC.AnzsicClassCode AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BAZC.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Sector BSTOR ON BLEC.SectorCode = BSTOR.SectorCode
WHERE BC.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
)A

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_SRC') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_SRC;

convert(varchar,CustomerID)

,convert(varchar,DateOfBirth)
,convert(varchar,MaritalStatus)

,convert(varchar,Country) 
,convert(varchar,Nationality) 
,convert(varchar,DataPrivacyConsent)
,convert(date,LastKYCDate)
,convert(char,SuspendedIndicator) 
,RelationshipStartDate
,convert(varchar,GlobalCIF)
,convert(varchar,FCBSCIF)
,convert(varchar,ATMEnrollmentIndicator)

,convert(varchar,OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator)

,convert(varchar,OfficeAddressLine2)

,BankSK

)) HASHROW, CustomerID,BankSK 
into DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_SRC
FROM DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_TGT') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_TGT;
END;

SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 convert(varchar,CustomerID)
,convert(varchar,CustomerName)
,convert(varchar,CustomerType)
,convert(varchar,DateOfBirth)
,convert(varchar,MaritalStatus)
,convert(varchar,Gender)
,convert(varchar,MobileNumber)
,convert(varchar,Email) 
,convert(varchar,AddressLine1)
,convert(varchar,AddressLine2)
,convert(varchar,City)   
,convert(varchar,Province)
,convert(varchar,ZipCode) 
,convert(varchar,Country) 
,convert(varchar,Nationality) 
,convert(varchar,DataPrivacyConsent)
,convert(date,LastKYCDate)
,convert(char,SuspendedIndicator) 
,RelationshipStartDate
,convert(varchar,GlobalCIF)
,convert(varchar,FCBSCIF)
,convert(varchar,ATMEnrollmentIndicator)
,convert(varchar,MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator)
,convert(varchar,OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator)
,GenerationalCohortSK
,convert(varchar,EmployerName)
,convert(varchar,OfficeAddressLine1)
,convert(varchar,OfficeAddressLine2)
,convert(varchar,OfficeCity)
,convert(varchar,OfficeProvince)
,convert(varchar,OfficeZipCode)
,convert(varchar,OfficeCountry)
,convert(varchar,Industry)
,convert(varchar,Occupation)
,convert(varchar,DateOfIncorporation)
,convert(varchar,SMEClassification)
,convert(varchar,LineOfActivity)
,convert(varchar,IndustryDescription)
,convert(int,Subsector) 
,convert(varchar,SubsectorDescription)
,BankSK
,BranchSK


)) HASHROW, CustomerID,BankSK  
into DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_TGT
FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMER WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND CustomerType = 'Corporate'

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_DELTA') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_DELTA;
END;


 SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	    WHEN TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	into 	DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_DELTA
FROM DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_SRC SRC 
LEFT JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL)

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, @DatetoProcessed))
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomer TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERCORP SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND TGT.CustomerType = 'Corporate';
